text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I ran into Mejiro Ardenn and
Yaeno Muteki in front of the hospital. They said they were
going to host a picture-book reading session in the pediatric ward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Today, we are planning to read
"Momotaro". Yaeno-san kindly
offered to assist—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was deeply moved by Ardenn-san's endeavors.
For this reading, I have been appointed
to play the role of Momotaro's companions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed.
It is much easier for the children to get immersed
if we divide up the character lines and perform them together.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, I can help out too!
If you don't mind, I'd love to help too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A picture-book reading session—such a wonderful activity sparked my interest.
Under Mejiro Ardenn's direction,
I was assigned the role of the dog!

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Big Sister Ardenn!
We've been waiting for you~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hello everyone.
I've brought books for you today as well.
choice_data_list: Do you already know the children?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When I was hospitalized previously,
they often spent time playing with me.
The smiles of these children were my comfort during my hospital stay—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Is that so.
Then they are precious friends of yours
as well, Ardenn-san.

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Boy A
text_block_list.text:
There's a new big sister!
She looks kind of strong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
My, my, if everyone hugs her all at once like that,
you will overwhelm her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Guh!
Such tiny, innocent lives... I-I must protect them...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, pull yourself together...!!
My duty today is to assist in the smooth
execution of this reading session...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All of you, silence!!
The picture-book reading session shall now commence.
Line up over there, sit down, and listen attentively!

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, the new big sister is so funny!

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Boy B
text_block_list.text:
We just have to sit in a line?
Then I'm sitting here~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is seated, I see.
You are all such well-behaved, good children.

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Girl B
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, look, I'm sitting cross-legged!

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Boy A
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, what story are we doing today~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, today it is "Momotaro".
Once upon a time, in a certain place—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I shall gladly assist you in defeating the demons,
but in exchange, please give me
one of those millet dumplings at your waist."

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Children
text_block_list.text:
Kibi dango? What's that~?
What does it taste like~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, millet dumplings are,
you see, sweet dumplings made from millet... a cousin grain of rice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
In the old days, sugar was scarce and luxurious,
so they might have seasoned it with starch syrup or honey...
I am certain it was a dumpling with a gentle sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Boy B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ is it soft?
I wanna eat some!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... then since we have the chance,
shall we borrow the kitchen and make some together?

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Girl B
text_block_list.text: Yay! We wanna make them, we wanna make them~!
choice_data_list: Is it alright to stop in the middle of the story?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
I wish to respect whatever
piques the children's curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us begin making the kibi dango.
Today, we will be using glutinous millet and starch syrup.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fire is hazardous, so I shall take charge
of boiling the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Then everyone else, let us knead the glutinous millet
and roll it into little dumplings.

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Boy B
text_block_list.text: Oka~y!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by Mejiro Ardenn,
the children were able to make plenty
of delicious-looking kibi dango!

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Girl A
text_block_list.text: The kibi dango is so chewy and yummy~!

text_block_list.name: Pediatric Ward Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Cooking is pretty easy!
I wanna make it again!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—As expected, people quickly comprehend and
retain things they are genuinely interested in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, truly... if their curiosity has expanded
and deepened their understanding of the story,
then I am delighted as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, my own motivation for learning classical Japanese
was born purely out of a burning desire to read martial arts scrolls.
Watching those children brings back memories—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
————Sparked by genuine interest...
If so, could the same apply to history—?
